features.quote: allow_give_up = True. Giving up is a measured outcome (disengagement), not a failure of the harness — so it's allowed and tracked
features.justification_quote: Giving up is a measured outcome (disengagement), not a failure of the harness

features.quote: max_turns = 24 (default, in AgentConfig). Rationale: this is the "dose" of failure.
features.justification_quote: 24 is enough to see escalation in a 1.5B model without blowing context or budget

features.justification_quote: prevents instability inflation; makes between-model comparisons the trustworthy signal
